passages.text: “Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity, I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about a future time.
God will restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity.
God will gather all the nations.
God will bring these nations down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat.
God will judge these nations there.
God will judge them because of His people, Israel.
Israel is God's inheritance.
The nations scattered Israel among themselves.
The nations divided up God's land.
passages.original: כִּ֗י הִנֵּ֛ה בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖מָּה וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָשׁוּב אֶת־ שְׁב֥וּת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ וְקִבַּצְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְה֣וֹרַדְתִּ֔ים אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֨י עִמָּ֜ם שָׁ֗ם עַל־ עַמִּ֨י וְנַחֲלָתִ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּזְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־ אַרְצִ֖י חִלֵּֽקוּ׃

passages.text: They cast lots for My people; they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink.
passages.sermon:
Foreign nations mistreated God's people Israel.
They gambled for the lives of God's people.
They traded a boy for a prostitute.
They sold a girl for wine.
They drank the wine they received.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ עַמִּ֖י יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ בַּזּוֹנָ֔ה וְהַיַּלְדָּ֛ה מָכְר֥וּ בַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃

passages.text: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia.
God asks them what they have against Him.
God asks if they are trying to pay Him back for something.
God says if they try to retaliate against Him, He will act quickly.
God promises to return their actions upon their own heads.
passages.original: וְ֠גַם מָה־ אַתֶּ֥ם לִי֙ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן וְכֹ֖ל גְּלִיל֣וֹת פְּלָ֑שֶׁת הַגְּמ֗וּל אַתֶּם֙ מְשַׁלְּמִ֣ים עָלָ֔י וְאִם־ גֹּמְלִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ עָלַ֔י קַ֣ל מְהֵרָ֔ה אָשִׁ֥יב גְּמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the nations.
You took My silver.
You took My gold.
You brought My finest treasures into your temples.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ כַּסְפִּ֥י וּזְהָבִ֖י לְקַחְתֶּ֑ם וּמַֽחֲמַדַּי֙ הַטֹּבִ֔ים הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם לְהֵיכְלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.
passages.sermon: The people of Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem.\r\nThey sold them to the Greeks.\r\nThey did this to remove the people of Judah and Jerusalem far from their homeland.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מְכַרְתֶּ֖ם לִבְנֵ֣י הַיְּוָנִ֑ים לְמַ֥עַן הַרְחִיקָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל גְּבוּלָֽם׃

passages.text: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God addresses those who sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
God says, “I will act.”
I will bring back the people you sold.
I will bring them from the places where you sent them.
I will repay you for what you have done.
I will bring your actions back upon your own heads.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֣י מְעִירָ֔ם מִן־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י גְמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD promises to act.
The LORD will sell your sons and daughters.
The LORD will give them into the hands of the people of Judah.
The people of Judah will sell your sons and daughters to the Sabeans.
The Sabeans are a distant nation.
The LORD has spoken this word.
passages.original: וּמָכַרְתִּ֞י אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְכָר֥וּם לִשְׁבָאיִ֖ם אֶל־ גּ֣וֹי רָח֑וֹק כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

passages.text: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the nations.
He commands them to listen.
He tells them to prepare for war.
He calls the mighty men to wake up.
He commands all warriors to come forward.
He tells every man of war to advance.
passages.original: קִרְאוּ־ זֹאת֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם קַדְּשׁ֖וּ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הָעִ֙ירוּ֙ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים יִגְּשׁ֣וּ יַֽעֲל֔וּ כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the nations.
He commands them to prepare for war.
He tells them to take their plowshares.
He tells them to make swords from their plowshares.
He tells them to take their pruning hooks.
He tells them to make spears from their pruning hooks.
He tells the weak people to speak boldly.
He tells the weak to say, “I am strong.”
passages.original: כֹּ֤תּוּ אִתֵּיכֶם֙ לַֽחֲרָב֔וֹת וּמַזְמְרֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם לִרְמָחִ֑ים הַֽחַלָּ֔שׁ יֹאמַ֖ר גִּבּ֥וֹר אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves. Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the nations around Israel.
He calls all the surrounding nations to come quickly.
He commands them to gather together in one place.
God asks the LORD to bring down His mighty ones.
passages.original: ע֣וּשׁוּ וָבֹ֧אוּ כָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וְנִקְבָּ֑צוּ שָׁ֕מָּה הַֽנְחַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.
passages.sermon:
God calls all nations to wake up.
God commands all nations to move forward.
God tells the nations to go to the Valley of Jehoshaphat.
God will sit in the valley.
God will judge every nation there.
God will judge all the nations that surround Israel.
passages.original: יֵע֙וֹרוּ֙ וְיַעֲל֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם אֵשֵׁ֛ב לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
passages.sermon:
God calls the nations to judgment.
He commands, "Swing the sickle."
The harvest is ripe.
He says, "Come, trample the grapes."
The winepress is full.
The wine vats overflow.
Their wickedness is great.
passages.original: שִׁלְח֣וּ מַגָּ֔ל כִּ֥י בָשַׁ֖ל קָצִ֑יר בֹּ֤אֽוּ רְדוּ֙ כִּֽי־ מָ֣לְאָה גַּ֔ת הֵשִׁ֙יקוּ֙ הַיְקָבִ֔ים כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה רָעָתָֽם׃

passages.text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
passages.sermon:
Many people gather.
They stand together in the valley of decision.
The Day of the LORD is near.
This day will come soon in the valley of decision.
passages.original: הֲמוֹנִ֣ים הֲמוֹנִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶֽחָר֑וּץ כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶחָרֽוּץ׃

passages.text: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.
passages.sermon:
The sun will grow dark.
The moon will also grow dark.
The stars will stop shining.
The sky will lose its light.
passages.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֖חַ קָדָ֑רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD lives in Zion.
The LORD roars from Zion.
The LORD raises His voice from Jerusalem.
Heaven will tremble.
Earth will tremble.
The LORD will protect His people.
The LORD will be a stronghold for the people of Israel.
passages.original: וַיהוָ֞ה מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֗ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ וְרָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיהוָה֙ מַֽחֲסֶ֣ה לְעַמּ֔וֹ וּמָע֖וֹז לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD lives in Zion.
Zion is the LORD’s holy mountain.
You will know this.
Jerusalem will be holy.
Foreigners will never enter Jerusalem again.
passages.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם שֹׁכֵ֖ן בְּצִיּ֣וֹן הַר־ קָדְשִׁ֑י וְהָיְתָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְזָרִ֥ים לֹא־ יַֽעַבְרוּ־ בָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃ס

passages.text: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.
passages.sermon:
On that day, the mountains will drip with sweet wine.
The hills will flow with milk.
All the streams of Judah will run with water.
A spring will flow from the house of the LORD.
This spring will water the Valley of Acacias.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִטְּפ֧וּ הֶהָרִ֣ים עָסִ֗יס וְהַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה חָלָ֔ב וְכָל־ אֲפִיקֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יֵ֣לְכוּ מָ֑יִם וּמַעְיָ֗ן מִבֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶת־ נַ֥חַל הַשִּׁטִּֽים׃

passages.text: Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
passages.sermon:
Egypt will become desolate.
Edom will become a desert wasteland.
The people of Egypt and Edom committed violence against the people of Judah.
They shed innocent blood in the land of Judah.
passages.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וֶאֱד֕וֹם לְמִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה מֵֽחֲמַס֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפְכ֥וּ דָם־ נָקִ֖יא בְּאַרְצָֽם׃

passages.text: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
passages.sermon: Judah will remain inhabited forever.\r\nJerusalem will last through every generation.
passages.original: וִיהוּדָ֖ה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְד֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

passages.text: For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged.” For the LORD dwells in Zion.
passages.sermon: The LORD lives in Zion.\r\nThe LORD has not yet avenged the blood of the people of Judah.\r\nThe LORD will avenge their blood.
passages.original: וְנִקֵּ֖יתִי דָּמָ֣ם לֹֽא־ נִקֵּ֑יתִי וַֽיהוָ֖ה שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
